decision_maker: Cabinet Member for Adults and Homes
purpose:
To consider a request for accelerated contract
approval to join Wave 1 of the Future of Prevention Academy, a
national programme bringing together local authorities to build the
foundations for proactive, AI-enabled prevention in adult social
care.
content:
To approve the commencement of a Procurement
of the Future Prevention Program in sufficient time to join Wave 1
of the Future of Prevention Academy.
 
Note: This decision was taken
under the General Exception provisions and the Standing Orders have
been complied with.   
 
The item could not be included on the 28 day
notice due to the need for accelerated approval. This is being
driven by a firm deadline of 26 June 2026 to join Wave 1, after
which there will be a gap of several months before the next
opportunity.
 
Joining Wave 1 is strategically important
because BNSSG + G are all participating together.
 
There is also a critical funding dependency:
ICB funding has been agreed specifically for participation
alongside system partners.
Executive approval is therefore being sought
urgently to:
-          
Secure a place in Wave 1
-          
Retain the confirmed ICB funding
-          
Enable joint delivery with system partners as planned
 
The Chair of Scrutiny was notified on 29/5/26
and the Statutory Notice published the same date 
General Exception Notice.
 
In accordance with Standing Order 107 the
decision will not be amenable to pre-implementation
call-in.  However, if members so wished
it can be called in for post-implementation review.
topline: The Cabinet Member for Adults and Homes has decided to approve the commencement of a Procurement of the Future Prevention Program to join Wave 1 of the Future of Prevention Academy.

To note that a full and detailed process of a
“community conversation” and market engagement have
been completed and provide a sound basis for decision making, agree
that the council will cease its direct operation of Grimsbury Farm, subject to a managed and phased
transition?making

To delegate authority to the Executive Director
–Place to oversee transition arrangements, stakeholder
communication and interim operational steps.

matters to be set out in a separate decision report to the Cabinet
Member for Corporate Resources.
